sn1.31:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || Atha kho sambahulā Satullapakayikā devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā || yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu || Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.31:2.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || seyyo hoti na pāpiyo ti || ||
sn1.31:3.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi. || ||
sn1.31:4.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || paññā labbhati nāññato ti || ||
sn1.31:5.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi ||
sn1.31:6.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || soka-majjhe na socatīti || ||
sn1.31:7.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.31:8.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññaya || ñāti-majjhe virocatīti ||
sn1.31:9.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.31:10.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || sattā gacchanti suggatin ti || ||
sn1.31:11.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.31:12.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || sattā tiṭṭhanti sātatan ti || ||
sn1.31:13.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavatam etad avoca || || Kassa nu kho Bhagavā subhāsitan ti || ||
sn1.31:14.1: Sabbāsaṃ vo subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena || api ca mamam pi suṇātha || ||
sn1.31:15.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || sabbadukkhā pamuccatīti || ||
